siteOptions.blogname: Monstera demo · Individual members, no organizations
siteOptions.blogdescription: People sign up on their own. A simpler portal: content, resources, a directory if you want one.

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
\Monstera\Plugin::runDevSeed( 'standalone' );
$state = (string) get_option( 'monstera_demo_seeded' );
if ( '1' !== $state ) {
	throw new RuntimeException( 'The "standalone" program did not finish cleanly (state: ' . $state . ').' );
}
